name: Major cyber incidents
summary: Record $6.3bn Binance theft blamed on North Korea; Russian alert app hacked on 2 Nov
state: The FBI said on 1 Nov that North Korea stole about $6.3bn from Binance in late October, the largest crypto theft on record. Russia's emergencies ministry said its public alert app was hit overnight into 2 Nov and used to send false messages. Belgium took its tax portal offline after an attack on 28 Oct. No national-scale outage of power or health systems was reported as of 2 Nov.
for_you: Be alert to phishing linked to data-breach news; NCSC guidance covers how to protect accounts.
rubric_hit: Attacks disrupting a major exchange and government services = Watch; theft, not destructive

rubric.alert: National-scale attack on critical infrastructure (power, health, finance), or a destructive state-attributed attack.
rubric.watch: Ransomware or attack disrupting a large company or critical service, or a mass-exploited zero-day.
